responsibility: Declares the shared data structures and helper APIs used by both flavors of RTL GCSE code, including modify_pair and gcse_note_stores_info plus routines for recording memory modifications and computing expression transparency. It is the common header that factors out alias- and MEM-tracking support from gcse-common.cc for consumption by gcse implementations.
same_name_distinction: Defines the shared data types and prototypes used by GCSE helpers, whereas gcc/gcse-common.cc contains their implementations. Unlike the .cc file’s actual MEM-recording and transparency-analysis code, this header just exposes modify_pair, gcse_note_stores_info, and the helper function declarations consumed by multiple GCSE variants.
